description: A jam company sends its product out in small and large jars. A small jar can hold 50 ml of jam while a large jar can hold 200 ml of jam. Most store prefer the smaller size and so the number of large jars cannot exceed the number of small jars. If the company wants to ship at least 100000 ml of jam, find the minimum number of jars that can be used.

SmallJarCapacity.definition: Capacity of a small jar in milliliters

LargeJarCapacity.definition: Capacity of a large jar in milliliters

MinJamVolume.definition: Minimum total volume of jam to ship in milliliters

MaxLargeJarsRatio.definition: Maximum allowed ratio of large jars to small jars

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of jars (small and large combined) used to ship at least the required amount of jam"

constraints.description: SmallJarCapacity * (number of small jars) + LargeJarCapacity * (number of large jars) >= MinJamVolume
The number of large jars cannot exceed MaxLargeJarsRatio times the number of small jars
The number of small jars must be a non-negative integer
The number of large jars must be a non-negative integer

smallJars.definition: Number of small jars used to ship jam

largeJars.definition: Number of large jars used to ship jam
